chunks: Sulaiman ibn Khalid asked him about making up the Witr after midday, so he said:
"Make it up as Witr always, just as it was missed."

key_terms.الْوِتْرِ: the single-unit Witr prayer from the night prayer
key_terms.قَضَاءِ: making up a missed act of worship

ai.seo_question: How should the missed Witr prayer be made up after midday?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about making up the missed Witr prayer after midday. The Imam عليه السلام instructs that it should still be performed as a single Witr prayer, in the same form in which it was originally missed.
